title: Interpretable Machine Learning Evaluates Differential Therapy Effects in Parkinsonian Gait — Supplementary Code and Data
description: Final supplementary code, derived gait and clinical-feature tables, and analysis results accompanying the accepted NeurIPS 2026 paper "Interpretable Machine Learning Evaluates Differential Therapy Effects in Parkinsonian Gait". Original software is licensed under MIT (LICENSE-CODE); author-produced derived data, results and documentation are licensed under CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-DATA and LICENSE-CONTENT). Raw participant trajectories and linked source clinical records are not included.
